items.docs: Create a Supe AI music supervisor search. Accepts a natural-language `query`, a `context` describing the scene, and/or up to 11 `asset_ids` (10 images + 1 video). At least one of `query`, `context`, or `asset_ids` is required. `callback_url` (HTTPS) is required for asynchronous delivery. Returns 200 immediately when an equivalent search is cached within 24 hours, otherwise 202 with a search ID; final results arrive via the configured webhook.
Retrieve the current status and results of a Supe search; refreshes signed audio URLs (which expire seven days after generation).
